prompt: Fix the Rational string-construction bug demonstrated by the deterministic reproduction below. A decimal numerator supplied as a string together with a denominator supplied as a string must preserve the intended rational value. Keep the change minimal, preserve existing behavior outside this case, and run the declared verification before finishing. Reproduction: from sympy import Rational; x = Rational("0.5", "100"); print(x); print(x == Rational(1, 200)).

args: from sympy import Rational; x=Rational('0.5','100'); assert str(x)=='1/200'; assert x == Rational(1,200)
